title.zh-CN: 发热、全身皮疹与黄疸 · 29岁女性
title.en: Fever, widespread rash and jaundice · 29-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 29岁女性高热一周，其间出现全身瘙痒性红疹，随后眼睛发黄，入院诊治。
summary.en: A 29-year-old woman has had a week of high fever, an itchy red rash that has spread over her body and, now, yellow eyes; she is admitted.

In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's own speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative (days before admission, 'five days later', day 25, about day 38). Version 1.0.0's unclear or inconsistent points are kept and listed to verify: the blood pressure 96/60 has no unit (shown as mmHg); the reference day of 'five days later', 'day 25' and 'about day 38' is not stated; 'no recurrence one year after stopping the medicines' does not say which medicines; the English 1.0.0 text dropped 'rapidly', 'blood-crusted' and the names of the imaging tests that its Chinese text gives. disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在发热、迅速扩展的皮疹伴面部水肿和肝损伤出现于开始用某药后2–6周时，识别伴嗜酸性粒细胞增多和系统症状的药物反应（DRESS；NICE CG183，2014），由白细胞分类算出嗜酸性粒细胞绝对值，并按已有资料逐项计算RegiSCAR评分（Kardaun 2007）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) when fever, a rapidly spreading rash with facial oedema and liver injury begin 2–6 weeks after a drug was started (NICE CG183, 2014), work out the absolute eosinophil count from the differential, and score the RegiSCAR items the record allows (Kardaun 2007).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按用药与起病的时间顺序判断可疑致敏药——起病前4–5周开始的药物，而不是出疹后加用的抗生素——并检查黏膜和皮肤剥脱，排查SJS/TEN重叠（英国皮肤科医师协会2016）。
learningOutcomes.en: Rank the suspect drugs by timing — the drug started four to five weeks before the illness, not the antibiotic added after the rash — and examine the mucosae and any peeling to exclude an SJS/TEN overlap (BAD 2016).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 治疗肝脏严重受累的DRESS：保持致敏药停用，不用非甾体抗炎药和非必需的新药，开始全身糖皮质激素（泼尼松约1 mg/kg/d，法国国家DRESS诊疗方案2024），并在6周至3个月内缓慢减量（2024年国际Delphi共识）。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat DRESS with severe liver involvement: keep the culprit stopped, add no NSAID or non-essential new drug, and start a systemic corticosteroid (prednisone about 1 mg/kg/day; French national DRESS protocol 2024) tapered over 6 weeks to 3 months (international Delphi consensus 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在皮疹好转而胆红素上升、凝血酶原活动度下降时识别肝衰竭风险，监测意识状态、扑翼样震颤和血糖，并与肝移植中心联系（ACG 2021；EASL 2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise threatened liver failure when the rash improves but bilirubin rises and prothrombin activity falls, monitor conscious level, asterixis and glucose, and discuss the patient with a liver transplant centre (ACG 2021; EASL 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 病程数周后再次发热和黄疸时，先排查感染、病毒再激活和新加药物，再恢复糖皮质激素剂量并更慢地减量（2024年国际Delphi共识）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage fever and jaundice returning weeks into the illness by looking for infection, viral reactivation and newly added drugs before restoring the corticosteroid dose and tapering more slowly (Delphi consensus 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 防止再次接触：把致敏药作为严重迟发型反应登记并发放警示卡，在过敏专科评估前避免非甾体抗炎药，绝不再激发，转诊药物过敏专科，并随访迟发性自身免疫并发症（NICE CG183，2014；Kano 2015）。
learningOutcomes.en: Prevent re-exposure: record the culprit as a severe delayed reaction with an alert card, avoid NSAIDs until an allergist has advised, never rechallenge, refer to a drug-allergy service, and follow up for late autoimmune complications (NICE CG183, 2014; Kano 2015).

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 发烧一个礼拜了，第二天身上起红疹子，这四天眼睛和小便都发黄
chiefComplaint.en: A week of fever, a red rash from the next day, and for four days my eyes and urine have been yellow

triageNote.zh-CN: 29岁女性，发热7天，起病次日出现瘙痒性红疹并扩展至全身，近4天眼黄、尿黄，收入院。体温39.2 ℃，血压96/60 mmHg。
triageNote.en: 29-year-old woman admitted with 7 days of fever, an itchy red rash from the next day that has spread over her body, and 4 days of yellow eyes and urine. Temperature 39.2 °C, BP 96/60 mmHg.

personality.zh-CN: 29岁，发烧一个礼拜了，身上痒，脸又红又肿，难受又害怕；问到什么就照实说，很配合，也很想知道自己到底得了什么病。
personality.en: 29, a week into a fever, itching where the rash is, her face red and puffy; she feels wretched and frightened, answers what she is asked plainly and cooperates, and badly wants to know what is wrong with her.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子短，不用医学术语；数字只说医生告诉过她的；药名只叫得出“布洛芬”和“青霉素”。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences, no medical terms; numbers only as the doctors told her; the only drug names she knows are 'ibuprofen' and 'penicillin'.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我发烧一个礼拜了，第二天身上就起了红疹子，痒，这几天眼睛也黄了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've had a fever for a week — the next day a red rash came up, it itches, and now my eyes have gone yellow.

concerns.zh-CN: 这到底是什么病？会不会传染给家里人？
concerns.en: What is this — could I pass it on to my family?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 入院时发着烧、身上痒、脸肿，紧张但配合，用自己的话回答，不用术语。只回答问到的内容，不增减任何数字、天数或药名；布洛芬吃多少、入院前那四天用的什么药、以前得过什么病、喝不喝酒、月经和别的药，一律说说不上来，不要编。五天后：烧退了、疹子在消，还是担心眼睛黄。第25天：前一阵好些了，现在又发烧、眼睛又黄，很灰心。不要说出诊断，也不要提前说后来的病情。
actingNotes.en: On admission she is feverish, itchy and puffy-faced, anxious but cooperative, and answers in her own words without medical terms. Answer only what is asked and never add or change a number, a day or a drug name; for the ibuprofen dose, the treatment in the four days before admission, past illnesses, alcohol, periods and other medicines, say you are not sure — never invent. Five days later: the fever has gone and the rash is fading, but she still worries about her yellow eyes. Day 25: she had been better, and now the fever is back and her eyes are yellow again; she is disheartened. Never name a diagnosis or describe what happens later.

description.zh-CN: 她因发热一周、全身瘙痒性红疹和黄疸住院。
description.en: She has been admitted with a week of fever, an itchy rash over her body and jaundice.

description.zh-CN: 五天过去了，她仍在住院。
description.en: Five days have passed; she is still in hospital.

description.zh-CN: 此后病情一度好转；到第25天，她又发热，眼睛又黄了。
description.en: She had improved in the meantime; on day 25 she is febrile again and her eyes are yellow again.

text.zh-CN: 报告把五天后的肝功能恶化（总胆红素255.9 μmol/L、白蛋白26.3 g/L、凝血酶原活动度37%、腹水）称为肝衰竭。治疗包括糖皮质激素和多种支持药物（其中有多种保肝药联用）；病情好转后，第25天再次发热、黄疸，此后逐渐恢复，约第38天肝功能恢复正常；停药后一年无复发。本病例没有记录各药物的名称、剂量和疗程，也没有记录肝性脑病评估、INR、人类疱疹病毒6型检测和过敏专科评估。单个病例无法区分各药物各自的作用。

The case does not record the drugs' names, doses or durations, any encephalopathy assessment, INR, human herpesvirus 6 testing or an allergy-specialist assessment. A single case cannot separate the effect of each drug.

harm.zh-CN: 严重迟发型药物反应（如DRESS）之后不做药物激发：再次接触可能引起更快、更重、甚至致命的复发。致敏药的确认交给药物过敏专科（NICE CG183，2014：严重非速发型反应后转诊专科），需要时在恢复后做斑贴试验，决不再挑战。
harm.en: No drug challenge after a severe delayed reaction such as DRESS: re-exposure can bring a faster, more severe and potentially fatal relapse. Confirming the culprit is for a drug-allergy service (NICE CG183, 2014: refer after a severe non-immediate reaction), using patch tests after recovery where appropriate — never a rechallenge.

dose.en: A potent topical corticosteroid to inflamed skin once or twice daily; emollients all over; care of the lips and mouth.

response.zh-CN: 已开始外用。本病例没有记录是否这样做过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Applied. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 经验性静脉β-内酰胺类抗生素

dose.zh-CN: 例如头孢曲松2 g静脉滴注，每日1次。
dose.en: For example ceftriaxone 2 g IV once daily.

harm.zh-CN: 她的发热、白细胞升高和偏低的血压可以用这次药物反应解释，本病例没有记录任何感染灶；在药物超敏反应活动期加用新的β-内酰胺类药物，可能诱发病情反复或新的过敏（DRESS中已有阿莫西林诱发病情加重的报道），何况青霉素正是出疹后才加用的。先做血培养、寻找感染灶，有感染证据或出现脓毒症时再用抗生素，并与感染科、过敏专科商量选用结构不同的药物。
harm.en: Her fever, raised white count and lowish blood pressure fit the drug reaction itself, and the case records no source of infection; a new β-lactam during an active drug hypersensitivity can provoke a flare or a new sensitisation (amoxicillin-triggered flares are described in DRESS) — and penicillin was itself added after the rash began. Take blood cultures and look for a source; give an antibiotic when there is evidence of infection or sepsis, choosing a structurally different drug with the infection and allergy teams.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。
response.en: Given.

dose.zh-CN: 请皮肤科医生今天来看她：皮疹范围、黏膜受累和有无表皮剥脱（尼氏征），是否需要皮肤活检。
dose.en: Ask the dermatologist to see her today: the extent of the rash, mucosal involvement and any epidermal detachment (Nikolsky's sign), and whether to biopsy.

response.zh-CN: 皮肤科医生今天会来看她。本病例没有记录是否这样做过；不模拟其效果。

dose.en: Ask the hepatologist to see her today: how severe the liver injury is, what to monitor and when to escalate.

response.zh-CN: 肝病科医生今天会来看她。本病例没有记录是否这样做过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The hepatologist will see her today. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 意识状态、扑翼样震颤和血糖监测
name.en: Conscious level, asterixis and glucose observations

dose.zh-CN: 定时（例如每4小时）评估意识状态和扑翼样震颤（West Haven分级）并测指尖血糖；每天复查凝血酶原活动度或INR和胆红素。
dose.en: At set intervals (for example 4-hourly): conscious level and asterixis (West Haven grade) and capillary glucose; prothrombin activity or INR and bilirubin daily.

response.zh-CN: 观察表已建立。本病例没有记录意识状态、扑翼样震颤、血糖或INR；不模拟结果。
response.en: The observation chart is started. The case records no conscious-level assessment, asterixis, glucose or INR; it does not simulate the results.

name.en: Discuss her with a liver transplant centre

dose.zh-CN: 今天就电话联系肝移植中心，说明胆红素、凝血酶原活动度、腹水和意识状态，商定转诊时机和肝脏支持治疗。
dose.en: Phone the liver transplant centre today with the bilirubin, prothrombin activity, ascites and conscious level, and agree the timing of transfer and any liver support.

response.zh-CN: 已联系肝移植中心。本病例没有记录是否这样做过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The transplant centre has been called. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉滴注乙酰半胱氨酸

dose.zh-CN: 按肝病科或肝移植中心的方案静脉滴注。
dose.en: IV infusion to the liver team's regimen.

response.zh-CN: 已开始输注。本病例没有记录是否这样做过；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 今天起不再给药。
dose.en: No further doses from today.

harm.zh-CN: DRESS在激素骤停或减量过快时容易复发，2024年国际Delphi共识建议重症患者的全身糖皮质激素在6周至3个月内逐渐减量。皮疹好转不是停药的理由，肝脏指标恶化也不是——后者提示需要评估肝衰竭风险。
harm.en: DRESS tends to flare when steroids are stopped suddenly or tapered too fast, and the 2024 international Delphi consensus tapers systemic glucocorticoids over 6 weeks to 3 months in severe disease. A settling rash is no reason to stop, and nor is a worsening liver — that is a signal to assess for liver failure.

response.zh-CN: 已停用。
response.en: Stopped.

dose.zh-CN: 例如甘草酸制剂、还原型谷胱甘肽和多烯磷脂酰胆碱同时静脉滴注。
dose.en: For example a glycyrrhizin preparation, reduced glutathione and polyene phosphatidylcholine together, IV.

harm.zh-CN: 在药物超敏反应活动期一次加用几种新药，会增加新的致敏和病情反复的风险，而没有证据表明这类联用能阻止肝衰竭；它们也不能替代糖皮质激素、严密监测和及早与肝移植中心联系（ACG 2021）。
harm.en: Several new drugs at once during an active drug hypersensitivity add to the risk of new sensitisation and flares, with no evidence that such combinations prevent liver failure; nor do they replace the steroid, close monitoring and an early call to a transplant centre (ACG 2021).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。治疗中用过多种保肝药联用有记录；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. A combination of liver-protective drugs is part of the recorded treatment; the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 今天出院，下周门诊复查肝功能。
dose.en: Home today, with liver tests in clinic next week.

harm.zh-CN: 皮疹消退、体温下降并不代表肝脏在好转：DRESS的肝损伤可以在皮疹好转时继续进展，病情还可能在数周内复发。肝脏严重受累需要住院监测胆红素、凝血酶原活动度和意识状态，并及早与肝移植中心联系（ACG 2021）。
harm.en: A fading rash and a normal temperature do not mean a recovering liver: in DRESS the liver injury can progress while the skin settles, and the illness can relapse over the following weeks. Severe liver involvement needs inpatient monitoring of bilirubin, prothrombin activity and conscious level, and an early call to a transplant centre (ACG 2021).

response.zh-CN: 已办理出院。
response.en: Discharged.

name.zh-CN: 恢复糖皮质激素剂量并放慢减量
name.en: Restore the corticosteroid dose and slow the taper

dose.zh-CN: 恢复到起始剂量（泼尼松约1 mg/kg/d或等效剂量），病情控制后更慢地减量。
dose.en: Back to the starting dose (prednisone about 1 mg/kg/day or equivalent), then a slower taper once controlled.

response.zh-CN: 已调整。本病例没有记录复发时做了什么；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Adjusted. The case does not record what was done at the recurrence; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 病情恢复、停用全身激素后由专科评估致敏药（必要时做斑贴试验），给出今后需避免和可以使用的药物清单。
dose.en: Specialist assessment of the culprit once she has recovered and is off systemic steroids (patch testing where appropriate), with a list of drugs to avoid and drugs she can use.

response.zh-CN: 转诊单已发出。本病例没有记录任何过敏专科评估；不模拟结果。
response.en: The referral is sent. The case records no allergy-specialist assessment; it does not simulate the result.

name.zh-CN: 出院后随访：甲状腺功能、血糖和肝功能
name.en: Follow-up tests after discharge: thyroid function, glucose and liver tests

dose.zh-CN: 出院后数月内复查甲状腺功能、血糖和肝功能，并告诉她出现乏力、口渴多尿或心慌时及时就诊。
dose.en: Thyroid function, glucose and liver tests over the following months, and advice to come back with tiredness, thirst and passing a lot of urine, or palpitations.

response.zh-CN: 随访已安排。本病例没有记录随访期间的甲状腺功能或血糖；不模拟结果。
response.en: Follow-up is arranged. The case records no thyroid or glucose tests during follow-up; it does not simulate the results.

title.zh-CN: 问清发热、皮疹、黄疸的经过和所有用药
title.en: Take the story of the fever, rash and jaundice — and every medicine

hint.zh-CN: 三个症状各从哪天开始、谁先谁后？发病前几周她在吃什么，发病后又加了什么？她以前吃药出过问题吗？
hint.en: When did each of the three symptoms begin, and in what order? What was she taking in the weeks before, and what was added afterwards? Has a medicine ever caused her a problem before?

title.zh-CN: 查看皮肤、口腔、眼睛和淋巴结，并读首批结果
title.en: Examine her skin, mouth, eyes and nodes, and read the first results

hint.zh-CN: 她的脸、躯干、口唇、眼睛和淋巴结各说明了什么？白细胞分类里的百分比换算成绝对值是多少？肝脏指标和凝血说明损伤有多重？
hint.en: What do her face, trunk, mouth, eyes and lymph nodes tell you? What is the eosinophil percentage as an absolute count? How badly do the liver tests and the clotting say the liver is injured?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁查看她的皮肤、口腔、眼睛和淋巴结；血标本在床旁采集，结果在病历终端或床旁的病历里查看。
guidance.en: Examine her skin, mouth, eyes and nodes at her bedside; blood is drawn there, and the results can be read at a records terminal or in her notes.

title.zh-CN: 判断病因，让第一天安全
title.en: Name the problem and make the first day safe

hint.zh-CN: 哪些病能同时解释发热、皮疹、淋巴结肿大和肝损伤？用药和症状的先后顺序说明了什么？她的肝脏受累有多重，治疗该用到什么强度？今天她的病历里必须写上什么，又有哪些药不能给？
hint.en: Which conditions explain fever, rash, enlarged nodes and hepatitis together, and what does the order of her medicines and symptoms tell you? How severe is her liver involvement, and how strong must the treatment be? What must go into her records today, and what must she not be given?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 1 和 2，并开出相应的医嘱。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and write the orders that go with them.

title.en: Reassess her liver five days on

hint.zh-CN: 皮疹和体温在好转，那么胆红素、白蛋白和凝血酶原活动度呢？关于她的神志和凝血，你还需要知道什么？今天需要让谁知道她的情况？
hint.en: The rash and the temperature are improving — what about the bilirubin, the albumin and the prothrombin activity? What else do you need to know about her mind and her clotting, and who needs to hear about her today?

guidance.zh-CN: 五天过去了，她仍在住院。
guidance.en: Five days have passed; she is still in hospital.

title.zh-CN: 处理第25天的再次发热，并为她出院后作打算
title.en: Manage the day-25 recurrence and plan beyond discharge

hint.zh-CN: 好转了的病为什么会在第三周以后又烧起来？哪些原因要先排除？她出院以后，怎样才能保证再也不碰到同一种药？
hint.en: Why would an illness that was improving flare again weeks later, and what must you exclude first? After she leaves hospital, how do you make sure she never meets the same drug again?

guidance.zh-CN: 第25天，她又发热，眼睛又黄了。
guidance.en: Day 25: she is febrile again, and her eyes are yellow again.

title.zh-CN: 对照报告记录的病程与结局
title.en: Compare with the reported course and outcome

hint.zh-CN: 报告的处理和你的处理有哪些相同、哪些不同？哪些问题这份记录回答不了？
hint.en: Where did the report's care match yours, and where did it differ? Which questions can this record not answer?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端查看报告记录的处理经过与结局。
guidance.en: Read the reported course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 29岁女性。入院前39天因膝痛开始连续服用缓释布洛芬；一年前服用含布洛芬药物后出现全身斑丘疹，停药后消退。入院前7天发热（最高41 ℃），次日面部和躯干出现红斑，迅速扩至全身并融合，伴瘙痒、眼睑肿，伴明显咽痛；出疹后用过青霉素2天，两药停用后又治疗4天，仍高热，皮疹和黄疸加重；入院前4天起眼黄、尿黄。查体：体温39.2 ℃，血压96/60 mmHg；面部水肿性红斑伴鳞屑，躯干剥脱，四肢融合性斑丘疹，口腔溃疡、唇部血痂，巩膜黄染，颌下淋巴结肿大伴压痛。白细胞11.62×10⁹/L，嗜酸性粒细胞6.7%，血红蛋白92 g/L；总胆红素133.6 μmol/L（直接117.5），ALT 585 U/L，AST 878 U/L，白蛋白33.9 g/L，凝血酶原活动度64%；肝炎病毒标志物、EB病毒和巨细胞病毒IgM阴性。你的工作诊断是什么？
prompt.en: A 29-year-old woman. She had taken sustained-release ibuprofen continuously for knee pain from 39 days before admission; a year earlier an ibuprofen-containing product gave her a widespread maculopapular rash that cleared when it was stopped. Fever (to 41 °C) began 7 days before admission, with facial and truncal erythema the next day that spread rapidly over the body and merged, itch, swollen eyelids and a marked sore throat; penicillin was given for 2 days after the rash appeared, and four days of treatment after both drugs were stopped left her still febrile with a worse rash and jaundice; yellow eyes and urine for 4 days. Temperature 39.2 °C, BP 96/60 mmHg; oedematous facial erythema with scaling, truncal peeling, a confluent maculopapular rash on the limbs, oral ulcers, blood-crusted lips, scleral icterus and enlarged, tender submandibular nodes. White cells 11.62×10⁹/L with 6.7% eosinophils, haemoglobin 92 g/L; bilirubin 133.6 μmol/L (direct 117.5), ALT 585 U/L, AST 878 U/L, albumin 33.9 g/L, prothrombin activity 64%; hepatitis virus markers, EBV IgM and CMV IgM negative. What is your working diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先问清症状经过和用药史，完成查体，并看过血常规、肝功能、凝血和病毒学结果。
need.en: Take the story and the drug history, examine her, and read the blood count, liver tests, clotting and viral serology first.

text.zh-CN: 布洛芬引起的伴嗜酸性粒细胞增多和系统症状的药物反应（DRESS），肝脏受累严重；口腔、唇部和躯干的表现要求同时排查SJS/TEN重叠
text.en: Drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) to the ibuprofen, with severe liver involvement; the mouth, lips and peeling trunk mean an SJS/TEN overlap must be looked for

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。发热、迅速扩展融合的皮疹伴面部水肿和鳞屑、淋巴结肿大、嗜酸性粒细胞绝对值约0.78×10⁹/L（11.62×6.7%）和严重肝损伤，出现在连续服用布洛芬4–5周之后，符合NICE药物过敏指南（CG183，2014）描述的DRESS（首次用药后2–6周起病）；青霉素是出疹后才加用的，不可能是诱因。此时RegiSCAR评分（Kardaun 2007）约3–5分（可能至很可能），因为病程能否超过15天还不知道。DRESS也可有口腔溃疡和唇炎，但仍要查尼氏征、表皮剥脱面积和眼、生殖器黏膜，必要时做皮肤活检，排除SJS/TEN（英国皮肤科医师协会2016）。
feedback.en: Right. Fever, a rapidly spreading, merging rash with facial oedema and scaling, enlarged nodes, an absolute eosinophil count of about 0.78×10⁹/L (11.62 × 6.7%) and severe liver injury four to five weeks into continuous ibuprofen fit DRESS as NICE describes it (CG183, 2014: onset 2–6 weeks after a drug is started); the penicillin came after the rash and cannot have started it. Her RegiSCAR score (Kardaun 2007) is about 3–5 at this point (possible to probable), because whether the illness outlasts 15 days is not yet known. Mouth ulcers and cheilitis occur in DRESS, but check Nikolsky's sign, the area of any detachment and the eyes and genitals, with a skin biopsy if in doubt, to exclude SJS/TEN (BAD 2016).

text.zh-CN: 青霉素引起的史-约综合征/中毒性表皮坏死松解症：口腔溃疡、唇部血痂和躯干剥脱提示表皮坏死，肝损伤只是它的并发症
text.en: Stevens–Johnson syndrome/toxic epidermal necrolysis from the penicillin: the mouth ulcers, crusted lips and peeling trunk mean epidermal necrosis, and the liver injury is only a complication of it

feedback.zh-CN: SJS/TEN必须排查，但这里更像DRESS：面部水肿和鳞屑、融合的斑丘疹、淋巴结肿大、嗜酸性粒细胞增多和严重肝损伤都是DRESS的特征，而记录中没有水疱、大片表皮松解或靶形损害。更关键的是时间：青霉素是发热、出疹以后才用的，不可能引发这场病；起病前4–5周开始连续服用的布洛芬才是首要怀疑对象。要查尼氏征和剥脱面积（英国皮肤科医师协会2016）来确认或排除重叠。
feedback.en: SJS/TEN must be excluded, but this looks like DRESS: facial oedema and scaling, a confluent maculopapular rash, enlarged nodes, eosinophilia and severe liver injury are DRESS features, and no blisters, sheets of detachment or target lesions are recorded. Timing settles the drug: penicillin came after the fever and rash and cannot have started the illness — the ibuprofen started four to five weeks before it is the suspect. Nikolsky's sign and the detached area (BAD 2016) confirm or exclude an overlap.

text.zh-CN: 成人斯蒂尔病：一周高热达41 ℃、明显咽痛、淋巴结肿痛、膝痛、白细胞升高和肝损伤；停用所有药物，查铁蛋白后开始激素
text.en: Adult-onset Still's disease: a week of fever to 41 °C, a marked sore throat, tender nodes, knee pain, a raised white count and hepatitis; stop every drug, check a ferritin and start steroids

feedback.zh-CN: 这是很好的鉴别，但成人斯蒂尔病是排除性诊断——Yamaguchi标准（1992）要求先排除感染、肿瘤和其他风湿病，药物反应也必须先排除。它的皮疹是随发热出现、一过性、不痒的橙红色斑疹，而不是迅速扩展、发痒、伴面部水肿和鳞屑的融合性皮疹；她的嗜酸性粒细胞增多、在连续服用布洛芬4–5周后起病，以及一年前对含布洛芬药物的皮疹，都指向药物。
feedback.en: A good differential, but adult-onset Still's disease is a diagnosis of exclusion — the Yamaguchi criteria (1992) exclude infection, malignancy and other rheumatic disease, and a drug reaction must go first. Its rash is evanescent, salmon-pink and not itchy, appearing with the fever spikes — not a spreading, itchy, confluent eruption with facial oedema and scaling; her eosinophilia, the onset four to five weeks into ibuprofen and last year's rash after an ibuprofen product all point to a drug.

text.zh-CN: 中毒性休克综合征：41 ℃高热、血压96/60 mmHg、弥漫性红斑伴脱屑、黏膜和肝脏受累；立即抗葡萄球菌和链球菌治疗，并寻找感染源
text.en: Toxic shock syndrome: fever to 41 °C, BP 96/60 mmHg, a diffuse erythema with peeling, and mucosal and liver involvement; anti-staphylococcal and anti-streptococcal treatment now, and a search for the source

feedback.zh-CN: 高热、红斑和脱屑时要想到中毒性休克，但她的血压96/60 mmHg达不到美国CDC 2011病例定义的收缩压≤90 mmHg，记录中受累的器官系统最多两个（口腔黏膜和肝脏），达不到定义要求的三个，也没有感染源；而面部水肿、嗜酸性粒细胞增多和连续服用布洛芬4–5周的时间线符合DRESS。血培养要做，但凭这个标签经验性使用β-内酰胺类，会在药物反应活动期再加新药。
feedback.en: Toxic shock belongs on the list with fever, erythema and peeling, but a BP of 96/60 mmHg does not meet the CDC 2011 case definition's systolic ≤ 90 mmHg, the record shows at most two of the three organ systems it requires (the mouth and the liver), and no source; facial oedema, eosinophilia and four to five weeks of ibuprofen fit DRESS. Take blood cultures — but empirical β-lactams on this label add new drugs to an active drug reaction.

prompt.zh-CN: 你的工作诊断是布洛芬引起的DRESS，肝脏受累严重（总胆红素133.6 μmol/L，ALT 585 U/L，凝血酶原活动度64%）。布洛芬和青霉素在入院前已停用；她体温39.2 ℃，血压96/60 mmHg，白细胞11.62×10⁹/L。今天怎么处理？
prompt.en: You are treating this as DRESS to ibuprofen with severe liver involvement (bilirubin 133.6 μmol/L, ALT 585 U/L, prothrombin activity 64%). The ibuprofen and the penicillin were stopped before admission; she is at 39.2 °C with a BP of 96/60 mmHg and white cells of 11.62×10⁹/L. What do you do today?

text.zh-CN: 两药继续停用，不用非甾体抗炎药和非必需的新药；留血培养；开始全身糖皮质激素（泼尼松约1 mg/kg/d）和皮肤护理，每天查肝功能和凝血
text.en: Keep both drugs stopped and add no NSAID or non-essential new drug; take blood cultures; start a systemic corticosteroid (prednisone about 1 mg/kg/day) with skin care, and check liver tests and clotting daily

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。停用致敏药是第一步治疗，新药——尤其非甾体抗炎药和抗生素——只用确有指征的。黄疸加上凝血酶原活动度降低，说明肝脏受累严重：2024年国际Delphi共识对重症DRESS使用全身糖皮质激素，并在6周至3个月内减量；法国国家DRESS诊疗方案（2024）的剂量约为泼尼松1 mg/kg/d。血培养回答感染问题，而不必先上抗生素。
feedback.en: Right. Withdrawing the culprit is the first treatment, and new drugs — NSAIDs and antibiotics above all — are kept to what is clearly needed. Jaundice with a reduced prothrombin activity makes her liver involvement severe: the 2024 international Delphi consensus gives systemic glucocorticoids in severe DRESS, tapered over 6 weeks to 3 months, and the French national DRESS protocol (2024) uses about 1 mg/kg/day of prednisone. Blood cultures answer the infection question without an antibiotic first.

text.zh-CN: 保持两药停用，单用强效外用糖皮质激素和润肤剂，全身激素留到皮疹继续加重时再用；留血培养，每天查肝功能和凝血
text.en: Keep both drugs stopped and treat with a very potent topical corticosteroid and emollients alone, keeping systemic steroids in reserve for a worsening rash; take blood cultures and check liver tests and clotting daily

feedback.zh-CN: 强效外用激素是2024年国际Delphi共识对轻、中度DRESS的治疗，但她有黄疸——总胆红素133.6 μmol/L、ALT 585 U/L、凝血酶原活动度64%——属于肝脏严重受累，共识建议使用全身糖皮质激素。等皮疹加重再用，看错了器官：威胁她生命的不是皮肤。
feedback.en: Very potent topical steroids are the 2024 Delphi consensus treatment for mild-to-moderate DRESS, but she is jaundiced — bilirubin 133.6 μmol/L, ALT 585 U/L, prothrombin activity 64% — which is severe liver involvement, for which the consensus gives systemic glucocorticoids. Waiting for the rash to worsen watches the wrong organ: her skin is not what threatens her life.

text.zh-CN: 按脓毒症处理：留血培养后立即静脉用第三代头孢菌素，糖皮质激素等血培养阴性后再考虑；退热用对乙酰氨基酚，每天查肝功能和凝血
text.en: Treat it as sepsis: blood cultures, then an IV third-generation cephalosporin at once, with steroids only once the cultures are negative; paracetamol for the fever, and liver tests and clotting daily

feedback.zh-CN: 留血培养是对的，但发热、白细胞升高和偏低的血压本身就是DRESS的表现，记录中也没有感染灶；在药物反应活动期加用新的β-内酰胺类可能诱发病情反复或新的过敏（DRESS中已有阿莫西林诱发加重的报道）。等48小时培养结果再用激素，会延误肝脏严重受累所需的治疗（2024年国际Delphi共识）；有感染证据或出现脓毒症时再用抗生素。
feedback.en: Cultures are right, but fever, a raised white count and a low-normal blood pressure are part of DRESS, and no source is recorded; a new β-lactam during an active drug reaction can provoke a flare or a new sensitisation (amoxicillin-triggered flares are described in DRESS). Holding steroids for 48 hours of cultures delays the treatment severe liver involvement needs (Delphi 2024); give an antibiotic when infection or sepsis is shown.

text.zh-CN: 静脉甲泼尼龙500 mg/d冲击3天后直接停用，尽量减少黄疸患者的激素暴露；保持两药停用、不加新药，留血培养，每天复查肝功能和凝血功能
text.en: IV methylprednisolone 500 mg daily for 3 days, then stop, to limit steroid exposure in a jaundiced patient; keep both drugs stopped, take blood cultures and check liver tests and clotting daily

feedback.zh-CN: 冲击3天后直接停药，很容易复发：DRESS在激素骤停或减量过快时常常反复，2024年国际Delphi共识建议全身糖皮质激素在6周至3个月内逐渐减量。黄疸患者使用激素确有代价，但对策是严密监测，而不是骤停。
feedback.en: Three days of pulses and an abrupt stop invite a relapse: DRESS commonly flares when steroids are withdrawn suddenly or quickly, and the 2024 Delphi consensus tapers systemic glucocorticoids over 6 weeks to 3 months. Steroids carry a real cost in a jaundiced patient, but the answer is close monitoring, not a sudden stop.

prompt.zh-CN: 五天后：热已退，皮疹减轻。总胆红素由133.6升至255.9 μmol/L，白蛋白由33.9降至26.3 g/L，凝血酶原活动度由64%降至37%，并出现腹水。意识状态和INR没有记录。现在怎么判断、怎么处理？
prompt.en: Five days later the fever has gone and the rash has lessened. Bilirubin has risen from 133.6 to 255.9 μmol/L, albumin has fallen from 33.9 to 26.3 g/L and prothrombin activity from 64% to 37%, and ascites has appeared. No conscious-level assessment or INR is recorded. How do you read this, and what do you do?

need.zh-CN: 先看五天后的肝功能、凝血和病程记录。
need.en: Read the liver tests, the clotting and the progress note from five days later first.

text.zh-CN: 按肝衰竭风险处理：定时查意识状态、扑翼样震颤和血糖，查INR；今天联系肝移植中心；激素继续用、不骤停，也不加非必需的新药
text.en: Treat it as threatened liver failure: chart conscious level, asterixis and glucose, check the INR, call a liver transplant centre today, and keep the corticosteroid going with no abrupt stop and no non-essential new drug

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。皮疹和体温在好转，胆红素却从133.6升到255.9 μmol/L，凝血酶原活动度从64%降到37%，还出现了腹水：皮肤好转时肝脏正在衰竭。ACG 2021把伴进行性黄疸（无论有无凝血障碍）的药物性肝损伤患者转诊到可做肝移植的中心评估，EASL 2019也要求对药物性急性肝衰竭考虑肝移植；是否已经达到急性肝衰竭，要看肝性脑病和INR，而这两项都没有记录——所以必须去查，并监测血糖。此时骤停激素，只会在肝脏危机之上再加一次DRESS复发。
feedback.en: Right. The skin and temperature improved while bilirubin rose from 133.6 to 255.9 μmol/L, prothrombin activity fell from 64% to 37% and ascites appeared: the liver is failing as the rash settles. ACG 2021 refers drug-induced liver injury with progressive jaundice, with or without coagulopathy, to a transplant centre, and EASL (2019) asks for transplantation to be considered in drug-induced acute liver failure; whether this already is acute liver failure turns on encephalopathy and the INR, neither of them recorded — so look for both, and watch the glucose. Stopping the steroid suddenly now would add a DRESS flare to the liver crisis.

text.zh-CN: 肝功能是在用激素期间变差的，说明激素加重了肝损伤：立即停用激素，改用多种保肝药联合治疗，三天后复查肝功能和凝血酶原活动度
text.en: The liver worsened on the steroid, so the steroid is harming it: stop the corticosteroid now, switch to a combination of liver-protective drugs, and repeat the liver tests and prothrombin activity in three days

feedback.zh-CN: 没有证据表明是激素造成了恶化：停用致敏药后，DRESS的肝损伤仍可进展数天；而骤停激素会诱发复发（2024年国际Delphi共识：6周至3个月内减量）。多种保肝药联用等于在超敏反应活动期一次加几种新药，没有证据能阻止肝衰竭；凝血酶原活动度37%时，等三天也太久。这种多药保肝的做法接近报告当年的支持治疗。
feedback.en: Nothing shows the steroid caused this: DRESS hepatitis can progress for days after the culprit is stopped, and an abrupt stop invites a flare (Delphi 2024: taper over 6 weeks to 3 months). A combination of liver-protective drugs adds several new drugs to an active hypersensitivity with no evidence that it prevents liver failure, and three days is too long to wait at a prothrombin activity of 37%. Several liver-protective drugs together is close to the report's supportive care.

text.zh-CN: 热退、皮疹减轻，说明病情已经控制：开始减激素、安排出院，下周门诊复查肝功能和凝血，告诉她黄疸会比皮疹消得慢
text.en: No fever and a fading rash mean the illness is controlled: start tapering the steroid and plan discharge, with liver tests and clotting in clinic next week, telling her that the jaundice will clear more slowly than the rash

feedback.zh-CN: 这正是本病例要避开的陷阱：皮肤好转不等于肝脏好转。胆红素255.9 μmol/L、凝血酶原活动度37%和新出现的腹水是肝衰竭的危险信号，需要住院监测并与肝移植中心联系（ACG 2021）；DRESS还可能在数周后复发。
feedback.en: This is the trap the case is built around: a better skin is not a better liver. Bilirubin 255.9 μmol/L, prothrombin activity 37% and new ascites are warning signs of liver failure that need inpatient monitoring and a call to a transplant centre (ACG 2021) — and DRESS can relapse weeks later.

text.zh-CN: 腹水是现在的主要问题：开始利尿剂，大量放腹水并补充白蛋白，限制钠盐，一周后复查肝功能、凝血和腹部超声
text.en: The ascites is the main problem now: start a diuretic, drain a large volume with albumin, restrict salt, and repeat the liver tests, clotting and abdominal ultrasound in a week

feedback.zh-CN: 这里的腹水是肝脏合成功能衰竭的表现，不是主要问题：关键是她是否正在发生急性肝衰竭（意识状态、INR、血糖），以及是否已与肝移植中心联系（ACG 2021）。对可能正在衰竭的肝脏大量放腹水、使用利尿剂，有导致肾损伤的风险；怀疑感染时可做诊断性穿刺。
feedback.en: Here ascites is a sign of failing synthetic function, not the main problem: what matters is whether she is developing acute liver failure (conscious level, INR, glucose) and whether a transplant centre is involved (ACG 2021). Large-volume drainage and diuretics on a liver that may be failing risk kidney injury; a diagnostic tap is reasonable if infection is suspected.

prompt.zh-CN: 在糖皮质激素和多种支持药物治疗下，病情曾经好转；第25天她又发热，眼睛又黄了。复发时的化验结果和当时的激素剂量都没有记录。你的思路是什么？
prompt.en: On glucocorticoids and several supportive medicines she had improved; on day 25 she is febrile and jaundiced again. No laboratory result and no steroid dose are recorded for this point. How do you approach it?

need.zh-CN: 先看第25天的病程记录，并重新测体温、看巩膜。
need.en: Read the day-25 progress note, and take her temperature and look at her eyes again first.

text.zh-CN: 先按DRESS复发处理：核对入院后新加的药，留血培养找感染灶，查HHV-6和CMV DNA及肝功能；激素恢复到起始剂量后更慢地减量
text.en: Treat it as a DRESS relapse until shown otherwise: review the drugs added since admission, take blood cultures, send HHV-6 and CMV DNA and liver tests, and restore the steroid dose with a slower taper

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。起病后两到三周出现第二波是DRESS的特点，常伴人类疱疹病毒6型或巨细胞病毒再激活，也可由激素减量过快或新加的药物诱发；她在用激素，感染必须排除。2024年国际Delphi共识建议激素在6周至3个月内减量，巨细胞病毒载量高时考虑抗病毒治疗，对激素无效者再考虑静脉免疫球蛋白或环孢素。本病例没有记录第25天实际做了什么。
feedback.en: Right. A second wave two to three weeks after onset is typical of DRESS, often with human herpesvirus 6 or CMV reactivation, and a fast taper or a newly added drug can also set it off; on steroids, infection must be excluded. The 2024 Delphi consensus tapers over 6 weeks to 3 months, considers antiviral treatment for a high CMV load, and keeps IVIG or ciclosporin for disease that does not respond to corticosteroids. The case does not record what was done on day 25.

text.zh-CN: 用激素期间的发热就是感染：立即停用糖皮质激素，让她自身的抵抗力恢复，开始经验性广谱β-内酰胺类抗生素，等血培养结果再调整
text.en: Fever on steroids means infection until proven otherwise: stop the corticosteroid at once so that she can fight it, start an empirical broad-spectrum β-lactam, and adjust when the blood cultures come back

feedback.zh-CN: 感染必须排除，但在DRESS复发时骤停激素，等于撤掉治疗、诱发更重的反复；经验性β-内酰胺类又是一个可能诱发加重的新药。应留培养、找感染灶，对证实或高度怀疑的感染进行治疗——而不是突然停用激素。
feedback.en: Infection must be excluded, but stopping the steroid abruptly in a DRESS relapse removes the treatment and invites a worse flare, and an empirical β-lactam is one more new drug that can drive one. Take cultures, find the source and treat proven or strongly suspected infection — without a sudden stop.

text.zh-CN: 她在激素治疗中复发，说明激素已经失败：停用糖皮质激素，改用静脉免疫球蛋白2 g/kg单药治疗；既然已确诊DRESS，就不必再查病毒或感染
text.en: She has relapsed on the steroid, so the steroid has failed: stop it and switch to intravenous immunoglobulin 2 g/kg on its own; with DRESS already diagnosed there is no need to test for viruses or infection

feedback.zh-CN: 2024年国际Delphi共识在DRESS对糖皮质激素无效时才考虑静脉免疫球蛋白或环孢素——不是在一度好转后出现一次复发就替换，更不能不查感染、病毒再激活和新加药物。骤停激素还会再添一次撤药性反复。
feedback.en: The 2024 Delphi consensus considers IVIG or ciclosporin when DRESS does not respond to corticosteroids — not as a replacement after one relapse in a patient who had been improving, and never without first looking for infection, viral reactivation and newly added drugs. A sudden stop adds a withdrawal flare.

text.zh-CN: 后期波动在DRESS中很常见，多数会自行平息：维持目前的激素剂量，加用一种保肝药，一周后复查肝功能，其他检查暂时不做
text.en: Late fluctuations are common in DRESS and usually settle on their own: keep the current steroid dose, add a liver-protective drug, repeat the liver tests in a week and hold off on other tests for now

feedback.zh-CN: 复发确实常见，但并非无害：用激素期间再次发热、黄疸，需要立即留培养、查病毒DNA、核对用药和复查肝功能，而不是等一周。再加一种新药（保肝药）还会增加新的致敏风险。
feedback.en: Late flares are common but not benign: fever and jaundice returning on steroids need cultures, viral DNA tests, a drug review and liver tests now, not in a week — and another new drug (a liver-protective one) adds to the risk of new sensitisation.

prompt.zh-CN: 复发控制后她将出院。一年前她对一种含布洛芬的药物出过全身皮疹，这次又在连续服用布洛芬后发病。出院时你给她什么样的长期安全方案？
prompt.en: Once the relapse is controlled she will go home. A year ago an ibuprofen-containing product gave her a rash all over, and this illness followed weeks of ibuprofen. What long-term safety plan does she leave with?

need.zh-CN: 先处理第25天的复发（决策 4）。
need.en: Deal with the day-25 recurrence first (decision 4).

text.zh-CN: 把布洛芬作为严重迟发型药物反应的致敏药登记并发警示卡，书面告知在过敏专科评估前避免所有非甾体抗炎药（含含布洛芬的复方感冒止痛药）；注明青霉素是出疹后加用；转诊药物过敏专科；数月内随访甲状腺功能、血糖和肝功能
text.en: Record ibuprofen as the cause of a severe delayed drug reaction with an alert card, advise in writing against all NSAIDs — including cold and pain combinations containing ibuprofen — until an allergist has assessed her, note that the penicillin was added after the rash, refer to a drug-allergy service, and follow thyroid function, glucose and liver tests for months

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。NICE CG183（2014）要求把药物过敏连同药名、反应和时间记录下来，告诉患者需要避免哪些药物，并把DRESS这类严重非速发型反应转诊到药物过敏专科。她一年前已经对含布洛芬的药物出过反应——这条病史如果被记录、被解释，就能避免这次再接触。DRESS后还可出现迟发的自身免疫病（甲状腺炎、1型糖尿病；Kano 2015），所以随访不能只看肝脏。
feedback.en: Right. NICE CG183 (2014) asks that a drug allergy be recorded with the drug, the reaction and when it happened, that the person be told which drugs to avoid, and that a severe non-immediate reaction such as DRESS be referred to a specialist drug-allergy service. She had already reacted to an ibuprofen-containing product a year before — history that, recorded and explained, prevents a re-exposure. Late autoimmune disease (thyroiditis, type 1 diabetes) is reported after DRESS (Kano 2015), so follow-up goes beyond the liver.

text.zh-CN: 先把布洛芬记为“可疑过敏”；等她完全恢复、停用激素以后，在门诊监护下做小剂量布洛芬口服激发试验，确认或撤销这个标签；数月内随访肝功能、血糖和甲状腺功能
text.en: Record ibuprofen as a 'suspected' allergy, then once she has recovered and is off steroids, arrange a supervised low-dose oral ibuprofen challenge in clinic to confirm or remove the label; follow liver tests, glucose and thyroid function for months

feedback.zh-CN: DRESS之后不做药物激发：再次接触可能引起更快、更重、甚至致命的反应。NICE CG183（2014）要求的专科评估依靠病史、时间线，必要时在恢复后做斑贴试验——而不是激发。
feedback.en: No drug challenge after DRESS: re-exposure can cause a faster, more severe and potentially fatal reaction. The specialist assessment NICE CG183 (2014) asks for rests on the history, the timeline and, where appropriate, patch tests after recovery — not a challenge.

text.zh-CN: 把布洛芬登记为致敏药并发警示卡；她的膝痛改用另一种非甾体抗炎药萘普生，一个月后复查肝功能；转诊药物过敏专科，数月内随访甲状腺功能和血糖
text.en: Record ibuprofen as the culprit with an alert card; treat her knee pain with a different NSAID, naproxen, with liver tests after a month; refer to a drug-allergy service and follow thyroid function and glucose for months

feedback.zh-CN: 萘普生和布洛芬同属丙酸类非甾体抗炎药，是最可能交叉反应的一组（EAACI 2013非甾体抗炎药超敏反应分类）；其他非甾体抗炎药要等过敏专科的意见，何况她的肝脏刚刚恢复。膝痛的止痛方案应与过敏专科和肝病科共同商定。
feedback.en: Naproxen is a propionic-acid NSAID like ibuprofen, the group likeliest to cross-react (EAACI 2013 classification of NSAID hypersensitivity); other NSAIDs wait for the allergist, and her liver has only just recovered. Pain relief for her knee should be agreed with the allergy and liver teams.

text.zh-CN: 把布洛芬和所有青霉素类都登记为终身过敏并发警示卡；既然致敏药已经清楚，就不必再转诊过敏专科；数月内随访肝功能、血糖和甲状腺功能
text.en: Record ibuprofen and every penicillin as lifelong allergies with an alert card; since the culprit is clear, no allergy referral is needed; follow liver tests, glucose and thyroid function for months

feedback.zh-CN: 青霉素是在发热、出疹以后才用的，从时间上看并不是这次反应的诱因；不加评估就把所有青霉素类终身标为过敏，本身也有害处。而转诊专科正是NICE CG183（2014）对严重非速发型反应的要求——由专科判断她今后必须避免什么、可以安全使用什么。
feedback.en: Penicillin was started after the fever and rash, so by its timing it did not cause this reaction, and labelling every penicillin for life without assessment does harm of its own. The referral is exactly what NICE CG183 (2014) asks for after a severe non-immediate reaction — the specialist decides what she must avoid and what she can safely take.

text.zh-CN: 问清发热、皮疹、黄疸的起病顺序和入院前经过，以及布洛芬（何时开始、为何服用）、出疹后加用的青霉素和一年前的同类药物皮疹，并追问其他药物、饮酒和妊娠可能
text.en: Took the order of the fever, rash and jaundice and the course before admission, the ibuprofen (when it started and why), the penicillin added after the rash and last year's rash after an ibuprofen product, and asked about other medicines, alcohol and possible pregnancy

text.zh-CN: 测体温和血压，检查面部、躯干和四肢皮肤、口腔和口唇、巩膜、淋巴结和下肢水肿
text.en: Took her temperature and blood pressure and examined the skin of the face, trunk and limbs, the mouth and lips, the sclerae, the lymph nodes and the legs for oedema

text.zh-CN: 看过入院时的血常规、肝功能、凝血和病毒学结果，并在入院阶段送检血培养和肾功能
text.en: Read the admission blood count, liver tests, clotting and viral serology, and sent blood cultures and renal function in the admission phase

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即作出正确的工作诊断（决策 1）
text.en: Made the right working diagnosis at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对第一天的方案（决策 2），在入院阶段开始全身糖皮质激素，继续停用可疑药物，并请皮肤科和肝病科会诊
text.en: Chose the first-day plan at the first attempt (decision 2), started the systemic corticosteroid in the admission phase, kept the suspect drugs stopped and called dermatology and hepatology

text.zh-CN: 把布洛芬作为严重反应的致敏药写入过敏记录，且没有给任何非甾体抗炎药，也没有做布洛芬激发
text.en: Recorded ibuprofen in her allergy record as the cause of a severe reaction, and gave no NSAID and no ibuprofen challenge

text.zh-CN: 看过五天后的肝功能、凝血和病程记录，并首次作答即认出肝衰竭风险（决策 3）
text.en: Read the liver tests, clotting and progress note from five days later and recognised threatened liver failure at the first attempt (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 在复发之前就开始肝衰竭监测（意识状态、扑翼样震颤、血糖），并与肝移植中心联系
text.en: Started liver-failure observations (conscious level, asterixis, glucose) and called a liver transplant centre before the relapse phase

text.zh-CN: 没有经验性使用β-内酰胺类抗生素，没有骤停激素，没有联用多种保肝药，也没有让她提前出院
text.en: Gave no empirical β-lactam, did not stop the steroid abruptly, gave no combination of liver-protective drugs and did not discharge her early

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按DRESS复发处理（决策 4），在第25天送检血培养和病毒DNA，并恢复激素剂量
text.en: Handled the recurrence as a DRESS relapse at the first attempt (decision 4), sent blood cultures and viral DNA on day 25 and restored the steroid dose

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定长期安全方案（决策 5），转诊药物过敏专科并安排迟发并发症随访
text.en: Made the long-term safety plan at the first attempt (decision 5), referred her to a drug-allergy service and arranged follow-up for late complications

text.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge框架向她解释这次药物反应、肝脏风险、可能的复发和今后如何避免再接触
text.en: Explained to her, using the Calgary–Cambridge guide, the drug reaction, the risk to her liver, a possible relapse and how to avoid meeting the drug again

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评价谈话。开始：自我介绍，确保私密，先问她今天最想知道什么（她担心会不会传染给家人、肝能不能好）。收集信息：了解她对一年前那次皮疹知道多少、当时吃的是什么药、为什么后来又吃了布洛芬——不带责备。解释：分块说明并核对理解——这是对药物（最可能是治膝痛的布洛芬）的迟发型过敏反应，不会传染；它同时伤了皮肤和肝脏，皮疹会先好、肝脏可能更慢；为什么要用激素并慢慢减量，以及几周后可能再次发热。计划：共同商定——过敏记录和警示卡，看清复方感冒药、止痛药的成分表，就医、买药、看牙时都要说明，在过敏专科评估前不用任何非甾体抗炎药，膝痛的止痛方案另行商定；出院后的复查。结束：总结，请她复述关键内容，交代出现发热、皮疹、眼黄、意识改变或出血时立即就医。本病例没有记录与她的这次谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the conversation by the Calgary–Cambridge guide. Initiating: introduce yourself, ensure privacy and ask what she most wants to know today (she fears passing it on to her family and wonders whether her liver will recover). Gathering: find out what she knew about last year's rash, what the product was and how ibuprofen came to be taken again — without blame. Explaining: in chunks, checking as you go — this is a delayed allergic-type reaction to a medicine, most likely the ibuprofen she took for her knee; it is not catching; it has hurt both her skin and her liver, and the rash may settle before the liver does; why steroids are used and tapered slowly, and that the fever may return weeks later. Planning, shared: the allergy record and an alert card, reading the ingredients of cold and pain combinations, telling every doctor, pharmacist and dentist, no NSAID until an allergist has advised, a separate plan for her knee pain, and the follow-up tests. Closing: summarise, ask her to explain the key points back, and safety-net — come back at once with fever, rash, yellow eyes, confusion or bleeding. The case does not record this conversation.

name.zh-CN: 冯医生（内科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“把布洛芬、青霉素和三个症状排在一条时间线上，哪种药在发病前几周就开始了？”“嗜酸性粒细胞6.7%、白细胞11.62，绝对值是多少？为什么不能只看百分比？”“RegiSCAR现在能打几分，哪几项要等病程才知道？”“口腔溃疡、唇部血痂和躯干剥脱，提醒你还要查什么？”“她的肝脏受累算轻还是重？治疗强度要跟着哪个器官走？”“皮疹好了，肝脏呢？还缺什么信息才能说是肝衰竭？什么情况下你会给肝移植中心打电话？”“第三周以后又烧起来，你先想到哪几种原因？”“她一年前就对含布洛芬的药起过疹子，为什么还会再吃？这次你要在病历里写什么、告诉她什么？”。可以讲2024年国际Delphi共识、法国国家DRESS诊疗方案（2024）、RegiSCAR评分、英国皮肤科医师协会SJS/TEN指南（2016）、ACG 2021和EASL 2019药物性肝损伤指南、中国药物性肝损伤诊治指南（2023）和NICE CG183（2014）的相关原则；也可以指出一个值得追问的细节：既往已对同类药物致敏的人再次服用后常在几天内发病，而她这次在连续服药约32天后才发热，所以一年前那次皮疹的药物成分和这次的致敏药都只能说“很可能”，需要过敏专科判断。原报告的处理（糖皮质激素和多种支持药物，包括多种保肝药联用）是历史记录，在病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；血小板、肾功能、人类疱疹病毒6型、INR、意识状态、激素剂量和减量方案都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has, for example: 'Put the ibuprofen, the penicillin and the three symptoms on one timeline — which drug started weeks before the illness?', 'Eosinophils 6.7% of 11.62 — what is the absolute count, and why is the percentage not enough?', 'How much of the RegiSCAR score can you give now, and which items must wait for the course?', 'The mouth ulcers, crusted lips and peeling trunk — what else do they make you check?', 'Is her liver involvement mild or severe, and which organ sets the strength of treatment?', 'The rash is better — and the liver? What is missing before you call this liver failure, and when would you phone a transplant centre?', 'A fever coming back after the third week — what causes do you think of first?', 'She had a rash after an ibuprofen product a year ago — how did she come to take it again, and what will you write and tell her this time?'. May explain the relevant principles of the 2024 international Delphi consensus, the French national DRESS protocol (2024), the RegiSCAR score, the BAD SJS/TEN guideline (2016), the ACG 2021 and EASL 2019 DILI guidelines, the 2023 Chinese DILI guideline and NICE CG183 (2014); and may point out a detail worth questioning: someone already sensitised to a drug usually reacts within days of taking it again, whereas her fever began about 32 days into continuous ibuprofen — so both what caused last year's rash and the culprit now are 'probable', for an allergist to assess. The report's management (glucocorticoids and several supportive medicines, including a combination of liver-protective drugs) is a historical record shown at the end of the case and compared with current guidance only then. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; the platelet count, renal function, human herpesvirus 6, INR, conscious level, the steroid dose and the taper are not recorded — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房责任护士。交班（ISBAR）：29岁女性，发热7天，起病次日出现瘙痒性红疹并扩展到全身，近4天眼黄、尿黄；入院时体温39.2 ℃，血压96/60 mmHg。可以协助建立静脉通路、留取血标本和血培养、物理降温、建立观察表（意识状态、血糖）、外用药和皮肤护理，并联系会诊医生和药师。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（心率、呼吸、血氧、体重、她以前的病历）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 29-year-old woman, 7 days of fever, an itchy rash from the next day that has spread over her body, and 4 days of yellow eyes and urine; on admission temperature 39.2 °C, BP 96/60 mmHg. Can place a cannula, take bloods and blood cultures, start physical cooling, set up an observation chart (conscious level, glucose), apply topical treatment and skin care, and call the consultants and the pharmacist. Reads back orders, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (heart rate, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, weight, her earlier notes).

knowledge.zh-CN: 皮肤科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：DRESS与SJS/TEN的床旁鉴别（面部水肿、浸润、紫癜、鳞屑与水疱、表皮松解、尼氏征、靶形损害和黏膜受累部位；SJS/TEN的剥脱面积和SCORTEN——英国皮肤科医师协会2016）；RegiSCAR评分的各项及分档（<2排除，2–3可能，4–5很可能，>5确诊；Kardaun 2007），以及嗜酸性粒细胞要看绝对值；日本DIHS标准把人类疱疹病毒6型再激活作为条件之一；2024年国际Delphi共识按肝、肾、血液受累分轻中重度，轻中度外用强效激素，重度用全身激素并在6周至3个月内减量，激素无效时考虑静脉免疫球蛋白或环孢素；恢复后由过敏专科评估，需要时做斑贴试验，绝不再激发。不说出诊断结论，不补充病例没有记录的数值或皮肤活检结果。
knowledge.en: Dermatology consultant who interprets only results the learner has read. Can explain: telling DRESS from SJS/TEN at the bedside (facial oedema, infiltration, purpura and scaling versus blisters, epidermal detachment, Nikolsky's sign, target lesions and the mucosal sites involved; the detached area and SCORTEN in SJS/TEN — BAD 2016); the RegiSCAR items and bands (< 2 excluded, 2–3 possible, 4–5 probable, > 5 definite; Kardaun 2007), and that eosinophils are counted as an absolute number; that the Japanese DIHS criteria include human herpesvirus 6 reactivation; the 2024 international Delphi consensus — severity graded by liver, kidney and blood involvement, very potent topical steroids for mild-to-moderate disease, systemic steroids tapered over 6 weeks to 3 months for severe disease, IVIG or ciclosporin when steroids fail; and allergy assessment after recovery, with patch tests where appropriate and never a rechallenge. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no values or biopsy findings the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 肝病科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：药物性肝损伤是排除性诊断，靠详细的用药史和排除其他病因（中国药物性肝损伤诊治指南2023）；没有碱性磷酸酶就算不出R值，只能说转氨酶明显升高并伴黄疸；凝血酶原活动度和INR的区别，以及本病例只记录了前者；西方定义的急性肝衰竭需要凝血障碍加肝性脑病（EASL 2017），而意识状态在这里没有记录；中国《肝衰竭诊治指南（2024年版）》有自己的分类；伴进行性黄疸（无论有无凝血障碍）的药物性肝损伤要转到可做肝移植的中心评估（ACG 2021），药物性急性肝衰竭要考虑肝移植（EASL 2019）；成人特异质性药物性肝损伤所致早期急性肝衰竭可考虑静脉乙酰半胱氨酸（ACG 2021，有条件推荐）；激素在一般药物性肝损伤中有争议，用于DRESS是针对超敏反应本身。不说出诊断结论，不补充病例没有记录的数值。
knowledge.en: Hepatology consultant who interprets only results the learner has read. Can explain: drug-induced liver injury is a diagnosis of exclusion, resting on a detailed drug history and the exclusion of other causes (2023 Chinese DILI guideline); without an alkaline phosphatase the R ratio cannot be calculated, so the most one can say is marked transaminase rise with jaundice; prothrombin activity versus INR, and that only the former is recorded here; Western acute liver failure needs coagulopathy plus encephalopathy (EASL 2017), and her conscious level is not recorded; the Chinese liver-failure guideline (2024) has its own categories; DILI with progressive jaundice, with or without coagulopathy, goes to a transplant centre for assessment (ACG 2021), and transplantation is considered in drug-induced acute liver failure (EASL 2019); IV acetylcysteine may be considered in early acute liver failure from idiosyncratic DILI in adults (ACG 2021, conditional); steroids are debated in DILI generally, and in DRESS they treat the hypersensitivity itself. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no values the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师。可以讲：把每种药的开始和停用时间与症状排成时间线，起病前2–6周开始的药是首要怀疑对象（NICE CG183，2014）；过敏记录要写明药名、反应、时间和处理，并告诉患者需要避免什么；布洛芬属丙酸类非甾体抗炎药，同类还有萘普生、酮洛芬、氟比洛芬等，交叉反应可能性最大（EAACI 2013），在过敏专科评估前避免所有非甾体抗炎药；许多复方感冒药和止痛药含布洛芬，要教她看成分表；一年前那次“含布洛芬的药”具体是什么，值得追问；在超敏反应活动期尽量不加新药。不说出诊断结论，不补充病例没有记录的药名或剂量。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist. Can explain: lining up each drug's start and stop against the symptoms, with a drug started 2–6 weeks before the illness the prime suspect (NICE CG183, 2014); an allergy record naming the drug, the reaction, the date and what was done, and telling the patient what to avoid; ibuprofen is a propionic-acid NSAID, like naproxen, ketoprofen and flurbiprofen, the likeliest to cross-react (EAACI 2013), so all NSAIDs wait for an allergist's advice; many cold and pain combinations contain ibuprofen, so she needs to read ingredient lists; the 'ibuprofen-containing product' of a year ago is worth identifying; and new drugs are best avoided during an active hypersensitivity. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no drug names or doses the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：布洛芬相关DRESS伴严重肝损伤
title.en: Debrief: DRESS with severe liver involvement after ibuprofen

conclusion.zh-CN: 29岁女性因膝痛自入院前39天起连续服用缓释布洛芬；一年前曾服含布洛芬药物后出现全身斑丘疹。入院前7天发热（最高41 ℃），次日出现迅速扩展融合的瘙痒性红斑、眼睑肿和明显咽痛，随后黄疸；出疹后加用的青霉素和停药后4天的治疗都没能止住病情。入院时体温39.2 ℃、血压96/60 mmHg，面部水肿性红斑伴鳞屑、躯干剥脱、口腔溃疡、唇部血痂、颌下淋巴结肿痛；白细胞11.62×10⁹/L，嗜酸性粒细胞6.7%（约0.78×10⁹/L），总胆红素133.6 μmol/L，ALT 585 U/L，凝血酶原活动度64%。五天后热退疹减，胆红素却升至255.9 μmol/L、凝血酶原活动度降至37%并出现腹水，报告称为肝衰竭；经糖皮质激素和多种支持药物治疗好转，第25天复发，约第38天肝功能恢复正常，停药后一年无复发。按现行指南：尽早识别DRESS，不用非甾体抗炎药和非必需的新药，全身激素并缓慢减量，皮疹好转而肝脏恶化时按肝衰竭风险处理并联系肝移植中心，终身记录并避免致敏药。
conclusion.en: A 29-year-old had taken sustained-release ibuprofen continuously for knee pain from 39 days before admission; a year earlier an ibuprofen-containing product had caused a widespread maculopapular rash. Fever (to 41 °C) began 7 days before admission, then a spreading, merging itchy erythema, swollen eyelids, a sore throat and jaundice. On admission: 39.2 °C, BP 96/60 mmHg, oedematous facial erythema, truncal peeling, oral ulcers, crusted lips, tender submandibular nodes; white cells 11.62×10⁹/L with 6.7% eosinophils (≈0.78×10⁹/L), bilirubin 133.6 μmol/L, ALT 585 U/L, prothrombin activity 64%. Five days later the rash and fever settled while bilirubin rose to 255.9 μmol/L, prothrombin activity fell to 37% and ascites appeared — reported as liver failure. With glucocorticoids and supportive drugs she improved, relapsed on day 25 and had normal liver tests by about day 38. Today: name DRESS early, give no NSAID or needless new drug, use systemic steroids with a slow taper, treat a better skin with a worse liver as threatened liver failure and call a transplant centre, and record the culprit for life.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 把用药和症状排在一条时间线上：布洛芬自入院前39天开始，发热在入院前7天出现（连续服药约32天后），皮疹在次日，青霉素在出疹以后——在发病前几周就开始的药才是嫌疑对象。
keyReasoning.en: Line the drugs up against the illness: ibuprofen from 39 days before admission, fever 7 days before admission (about 32 days into it), the rash the next day, penicillin only after the rash — the drug that preceded the illness by weeks is the suspect.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 把所见合在一起：发热、迅速扩展融合并伴面部水肿和鳞屑的皮疹、淋巴结肿痛、嗜酸性粒细胞约0.78×10⁹/L和伴黄疸的肝细胞损伤——这是累及多系统的药物反应，而不只是一场皮疹。
keyReasoning.en: Put the findings together: fever, a spreading, merging rash with facial oedema and scaling, tender nodes, eosinophils of about 0.78×10⁹/L and hepatocellular injury with jaundice — a multisystem drug reaction, not a rash alone.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 主动寻找危险的重叠和类似病：SJS/TEN（黏膜、剥脱）、感染（血培养、感染灶）、成人斯蒂尔病和中毒性休克——并说清哪些检查本病例没有记录。
keyReasoning.en: Look for the dangerous overlaps and mimics — SJS/TEN (mucosae, peeling), infection (cultures, a source), adult-onset Still's disease and toxic shock — and say what the case does not record.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 按器官分别评估严重度：肝脏（胆红素133.6 μmol/L、凝血酶原活动度64%）决定这是重症，需要全身激素；皮肤不是衡量标准。
keyReasoning.en: Grade the organs separately: the liver (bilirubin 133.6 μmol/L, prothrombin activity 64%) makes this severe and calls for systemic steroids; the skin is not the yardstick.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 五天后皮疹好转，而胆红素升到255.9 μmol/L、凝血酶原活动度降到37%并出现腹水：重新评估肝脏，查意识状态和INR，联系肝移植中心。
keyReasoning.en: Five days on, the rash improved while bilirubin reached 255.9 μmol/L, prothrombin activity fell to 37% and ascites appeared: re-grade the liver, look for encephalopathy and the INR, and call a transplant centre.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 第25天再次发热、黄疸，先按复发处理（药物、感染、病毒再激活、减量），长期方案的核心是她再也不会碰到布洛芬。
keyReasoning.en: Fever and jaundice on day 25 are a relapse until shown otherwise (drugs, infection, viral reactivation, the taper), and the long-term plan is about her never meeting ibuprofen again.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别与评分：DRESS通常在首次用药后2–6周起病，再次接触时可在3天内发病（NICE CG183，2014）；她在连续服用布洛芬约32天后发热，青霉素是起病后才用的。嗜酸性粒细胞要算绝对值：11.62×0.067≈0.78×10⁹/L，6.7%看似不高，但≥0.7×10⁹/L在RegiSCAR评分（Kardaun 2007）中得1分。RegiSCAR <2分排除、2–3分可能、4–5分很可能、>5分确诊：入院时因病程是否超过15天未知，约3–5分；病程延长后约4–6分。日本DIHS标准要求人类疱疹病毒6型再激活，本病例没有检测；原报告使用的是DIHS这一名称。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition and scoring: DRESS usually starts 2–6 weeks after a drug is first taken, or within 3 days of a re-exposure (NICE CG183, 2014); her fever began about 32 days into continuous ibuprofen, and the penicillin came after the onset. Count eosinophils as an absolute number: 11.62 × 0.067 ≈ 0.78×10⁹/L — 6.7% looks unremarkable, but ≥ 0.7×10⁹/L earns a RegiSCAR point (Kardaun 2007). RegiSCAR < 2 excludes, 2–3 is possible, 4–5 probable, > 5 definite: about 3–5 on admission, with the 15-day item still unknown, and about 4–6 once the course is long. The Japanese DIHS criteria need human herpesvirus 6 reactivation, which was not tested; the report uses the term DIHS.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 排除SJS/TEN重叠：DRESS也可有唇炎和口腔溃疡，但口腔溃疡、唇部血痂加躯干剥脱，要求查尼氏征、表皮剥脱面积和眼、生殖器黏膜，必要时做皮肤活检（英国皮肤科医师协会SJS/TEN指南2016）；若为SJS/TEN，按剥脱面积和SCORTEN评估。本病例这些都没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Excluding an SJS/TEN overlap: DRESS can bring cheilitis and mouth ulcers, but ulcers, blood-crusted lips and a peeling trunk call for Nikolsky's sign, the detached area, the eyes and genitals, and a skin biopsy if in doubt (BAD SJS/TEN guideline 2016); if it is SJS/TEN, the detached area and SCORTEN follow. None of these is recorded in this case.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗：2024年国际Delphi共识按肝、肾、血液受累分轻中重度——轻中度外用强效激素，重度全身糖皮质激素，在6周至3个月内减量，激素无效时考虑静脉免疫球蛋白或环孢素，巨细胞病毒载量高时考虑抗病毒；法国国家DRESS诊疗方案（2024）重症用泼尼松约1 mg/kg/d。急性期避免非甾体抗炎药和非必需的新药，尤其是β-内酰胺类。原报告用了糖皮质激素和多种支持药物（含多种保肝药联用），剂量和时间没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment: the 2024 international Delphi consensus grades severity by liver, kidney and blood involvement — very potent topical steroids for mild-to-moderate disease, systemic glucocorticoids for severe disease tapered over 6 weeks to 3 months, IVIG or ciclosporin when steroids fail, and antiviral treatment for a high CMV load; the French national DRESS protocol (2024) uses prednisone about 1 mg/kg/day in severe disease. Avoid NSAIDs and needless new drugs, β-lactams above all, in the acute phase. The report used glucocorticoids and several supportive drugs, including a combination of liver-protective drugs; doses and timing are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 皮肤好转不等于肝脏好转：五天后胆红素由133.6升至255.9 μmol/L，白蛋白由33.9降至26.3 g/L，凝血酶原活动度由64%降至37%，并出现腹水。ACG 2021要求伴进行性黄疸（无论有无凝血障碍）的药物性肝损伤转诊到可做肝移植的中心，并对早期急性肝衰竭有条件推荐乙酰半胱氨酸；EASL 2017定义的急性肝衰竭需要凝血障碍加肝性脑病——本病例INR和意识状态都没有记录。报告称之为肝衰竭，这一称谓是否符合中国《肝衰竭诊治指南（2024年版）》的分类，有待核实。
teachingPoints.en: A better skin is not a better liver: five days on, bilirubin rose from 133.6 to 255.9 μmol/L, albumin fell from 33.9 to 26.3 g/L and prothrombin activity from 64% to 37%, with new ascites. ACG 2021 sends DILI with progressive jaundice, with or without coagulopathy, to a transplant centre and conditionally suggests acetylcysteine in early acute liver failure; EASL 2017 defines acute liver failure by coagulopathy plus encephalopathy — and neither the INR nor her conscious level is recorded. The report calls it liver failure; how that label maps onto the categories of the 2024 Chinese liver-failure guideline remains to be verified.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复发与随访：DRESS常在起病后2–3周出现第二波，多与人类疱疹病毒6型或巨细胞病毒再激活、激素减量过快或新加药物有关；她在第25天复发，约第38天肝功能恢复正常。DRESS痊愈后还可出现自身免疫性甲状腺病和暴发性1型糖尿病等迟发并发症（Kano 2015，145例随访），需要数月的随访。
teachingPoints.en: Relapse and follow-up: DRESS often has a second wave 2–3 weeks after onset, linked to human herpesvirus 6 or CMV reactivation, a fast taper or a newly added drug; she relapsed on day 25 and her liver tests were normal by about day 38. Autoimmune thyroid disease and fulminant type 1 diabetes can follow recovery (Kano 2015, 145 patients followed), so follow-up runs for months.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 防止再接触：按NICE CG183（2014）记录药名、反应和时间，告诉患者要避免什么，把严重非速发型反应转诊药物过敏专科；绝不再激发；在专科评估前避免非甾体抗炎药，尤其是萘普生等丙酸类（EAACI 2013），并教她识别含布洛芬的复方药。她一年前对含布洛芬药物的皮疹，正是每次都要问、都要记下来的那条病史。
teachingPoints.en: Preventing re-exposure: record the drug, the reaction and the date and tell the patient what to avoid, and refer a severe non-immediate reaction to a drug-allergy service (NICE CG183, 2014); never rechallenge; avoid NSAIDs — propionic acids such as naproxen above all (EAACI 2013) — until the allergist has advised, and teach her to spot ibuprofen in combination products. Her rash after an ibuprofen product a year earlier is exactly the history to ask about, and record, every time.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能说明激素或支持药物是否改变了病程，也只能把布洛芬判断为“很可能”的致敏药。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。“五天后”“第25天”“约第38天”按记录呈现，起算日没有写明；入院化验和影像的具体时间也没有记录，本病例把它们放在入院阶段。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show whether the steroids or the supportive drugs changed the course, and it can make ibuprofen only the 'probable' culprit. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. 'Five days later', 'day 25' and 'about day 38' are shown as recorded, with their reference day not stated; the exact timing of the first blood tests and imaging is not recorded either, and the case places them in the admission phase.
